meta.title: SAWA — Every request. Every hour. Together.

hero.subtitle: One shared place for requests, timesheets, and approvals — no more chasing emails and spreadsheets.
hero.mockLabel: Example: a leave request moving from Submitted to Approved, with 3 approvals pending

pain.title: Sound familiar?
pain.subtitle: Most teams still handle requests and timesheets the hard way.

visibility.title: No visibility
visibility.body: Requests get lost across email, WhatsApp, and paper forms.

accountability.title: No accountability
accountability.body: Decisions happen in side chats, with no record to look back on.

time.title: Wasted time
time.body: Managers chase timesheets every week, and HR spends days merging spreadsheets.

shift.title: Everything, together.
shift.body: One place where every request and every hour has an owner, a status, and a history.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps, the same for every request and every timesheet.

submit.title: Submit
submit.body: Send a request or log your hours in under 2 minutes, from any device.

review.title: Review
review.body: Your manager approves, rejects, or returns it with a comment.

track.title: Track
track.body: Everyone sees the live status, and HR sees the whole organization.

roles.title: Built for every role
roles.subtitle: Everyone gets the view they need — nothing more, nothing less.

employee.b1: See every request and its status in one place.
employee.b2: Submit a leave request in under 2 minutes.
employee.b3: Get notified when something is approved or needs changes.

manager.b1: All pending team requests and timesheets on one dashboard.
manager.b2: Approve, reject, or return with a comment.
manager.b3: Filter by type, status, or team member.

hr.name: HR
hr.b1: An organization-wide view of pending requests and hours.
hr.b2: Working-hour and request reports in minutes, not days.
hr.b3: A full audit trail of every decision.

access.title: Role-based access
access.body: People see only what their role allows.

history.title: Full status history
history.body: Every change, with who made it and when.

cta.title: Bring your team together.
cta.body: Sign in with the account your HR team set up for you.
